basic_info.description: 2768 Green Street is a penthouse of a three unit condo converted of a high quality home located in prestigious Pacific Heights neighborhood. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, a state-of-art kitchen, a spacious living-dining room with expansive windows showcasing magnificent panoramic views of Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco Bay, the Palace of Fine Arts, Alcatraz Island, and beautiful sunsets over Pacific Ocean. There are ample storage in basement and attic, and a high-quality, recently completely remodeled garage guaranteed to be available for this property across the street at 2701 Green Street.The home is located in the most serene and secured beautiful neighborhood with easy access to Presidio, St. Francis Yacht Club, Tunnel Tops park, Crissy Field, Marina Green, Fort Mason and within walking distance to many fine restaurants and shops on Union Street, Chestnut Street and Fillmore Street. The Golden Gate Bridge and Marin Headlands are just a short drive away. The two blocks on Green Street between Lyon and Broderick have private security protection in place during the night.
